h: The Call to Teshuvah Within a Desolate Heart

p: In the haftarah of this parsha (Yeshayahu 40:3):
who keep Shabbos according to its laws,
the world is judged by its majority,
and the majority are not so,
that is, even to the souls
it says, "Clear the way of Hashem":
that is, the way of Torah,
"Fortunate are those whose way is perfect,
who walk in the Torah of Hashem."
as it says in the name of the Baal Shem Tov,
may the memory of the tzaddik be for a blessing,
that this is the thoughts of teshuvah
and what is the intent of his existence.
which is also a desolate place
in the manner of what it says (Berachos 59a):
to straighten the crookedness of the heart";
"these are those in whom the paths of the Torah
for he brings coldness and sadness
into the heart of a person,
to grow lax in words of Torah,
on the grounds that his deeds are not proper,
and therefore his Torah and service
And as we find with Yaabetz:
in the days of mourning for Moshe,
לְבִלְתִּי עׇצְבִּי (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים א ד, י)
"that it not grieve me" (Divrei HaYamim I 4:10)
"that the yetzer hara not overpower me
And for this strengthening of the heart is needed,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים ב יז, ו)
"And his heart was lifted up in the ways of Hashem";
About this the promise is said:
"And every mountain and hill shall be made low"
this is the lowering of the yetzer hara,
which is likened to a mountain,
"the heart of a fool at his left";
"and gladness for the upright in heart."
"And the glory of Hashem shall be revealed,
and all flesh shall see together
that the mouth of Hashem has spoken"
that it will be perceptibly revealed
is truly the mouth of Hashem,
which gives the power of arousal in his heart.
And this is akin to the holiness of Shabbos,
by whose merit Yisrael are redeemed;
"If you restrain your foot because of Shabbos," etc.,
"then you shall delight in Hashem," etc.,
"for the mouth of Hashem has spoken."
